subject: computer-science
title: Software Development Lifecycle
welcome_lead: From idea to deployment: discover waterfall, agile and the modern SDLC.
meta_desc: CS adventure on the software development lifecycle, waterfall vs agile.
final_note: SDLC tames complexity through planned phases!

concepts.def: Agile framework using sprints and roles.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Stages: analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, maintenance.

Each stage produces artifacts to guide the next.

Waterfall: rigid, suited for fixed requirements.

Agile: flexible sprints, embraces change, frequent delivery to stakeholders.

Product Owner sets priorities; Scrum Master coaches process.

Development Team builds increments in time-boxed sprints (typically 1-4 weeks).
